title: A Novel Photocyclization Reaction of Lysine–Anthraquinone Molecules
abstract: Abstract                Nα-Acetyl-Nε-(2-anthraquinonyl)-L-lysine methyl ester underwent a photocyclization reaction in an acetonitrile solution to produce piperidine derivatives. The cyclization might proceed via a novel process that carbon-centered radical formed at the ε-position attacked the α-amido group in the molecule, followed by the formation of C–N bond.
